findings.description: The separator selection is inverted: the original code used "; " when any_prefix_is_slash was true and " / " otherwise, but the new code uses "; " when it is false and " / " when it is true.
findings.rationale: For a normal option such as --verbose with prefix '-' and '--' (any_prefix_is_slash is False), the new expression picks "; " and produces a different left column than before. For slash-prefixed options such as /debug the separator also flips. Every option's help left column changes, so help output for ordinary options is wrong.
